citations.quote:
[name="？？？"]结城哥？！
[name="？？？"]结城哥……是你吗？
[name="结城理"]虎狼丸，还有天田……！
[name="？？？"]太好了……虎狼丸真的找到结城哥了！
[name="吉阿达"]结城……？
[name="结城理"]嗯，这就是我的同伴……其中的两位。这位是天田乾，另一位……名叫虎狼丸。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Image]
[Background(image="26_g9_laterano_street",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2388_1#1$3",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="天田乾"]……您好？
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4220_kormr_1#4$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_dogbarknormal", volume=1)]
[name="虎狼丸"]汪呜汪呜！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]啊哈哈哈，还好生活用品还没买，不用多跑一趟了……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#12$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]（小声）裘里奥，这是……循兽？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]（小声）……更像是佩洛兽亲？嗯……佩洛兽亲吃循兽粮吗？
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4220_kormr_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="虎狼丸"]汪？
[Dialog]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Image]
[Background(image="77_g1_dorm",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[playMusic(intro="$m_avg2_act54side_intro",key="$m_avg2_act54side_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]……好了，和结城的老师联络过了，天田今天可以住在宿舍。之后也要去公证所和学校登记报到。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]啊哈哈……又多出来一个表弟啊……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]小理，你要不然，先稍微和我们讲一点你同伴的事？比如，一共有几个人之类的……？
[name="裘里奥"]我好确认一下我的亲戚数量。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#5$4",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="结城理")]包括我在内，这次一起行……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#1$4",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="结城理")]一起来拉特兰的同伴应该有五名，再加上虎狼丸。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]那……吉阿达，咱俩分分？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#11$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]……不用每个人都装成亲戚吧，按照公民亲属的亲友身份登记应该也可以。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#1$4",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2388_1#13$3",focus="r")]
[name="天田乾"]（小声）结城哥，这是怎么回事……？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#2$4",focus="l")]
[name="结城理"]（轻微摇头）
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#1$4",focus="l")]
[name="结城理"]就按吉阿达小姐说的办吧。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2388_1#1$3",focus="r")]
[name="天田乾"]那……总之非常感谢！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4220_kormr_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="虎狼丸"]汪！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]今天很累了吧，你们早点休息。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="裘里奥"]欸？不能再坐会儿吗，我也很累啊……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2378_1#2$1",focus="l")]
[name="吉阿达"]这里是学生宿舍。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[multiline(name="裘里奥")]好吧好吧……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2379_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[multiline(name="裘里奥")]之后再来看你们，再见啦！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",afrom=1, ato=0,duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",afrom=1, ato=0,duration=1.5)]
[delay(time=3)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4217_makoto_1#1$4",focus="m")]
[name="结城理"]……天田，虎狼丸，去我房间说吧。
[charslot]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2388_1#3$3")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4220_kormr_1#6$1")]
[name="天田乾&虎狼丸"]嗯！/嗷！
